data.long_description:
Experience exceptional luxury in this stunning 5-bedroom villa located in the prestigious Al Habtoor Polo Resort & Club. Designed for those who appreciate elegance, space, and a resort-inspired lifestyle, this residence offers a perfect blend of sophistication and comfort. The interiors are thoughtfully designed with high-end finishes, expansive living and dining areas, and large windows that fill the home with natural light.


Property Highlights:

5 Bedrooms
6 Bathrooms
Panoramic Polo View
Private Swimming Pool
Covered Parking
High-quality finishes
Large outdoor space
Spacious and elegant layout
Bright interiors with large windows
One of a kind community - Resort Living

The property boasts a modern kitchen, generously sized bedrooms with built-in wardrobes, and a seamless indoor-outdoor flow. The private outdoor space is ideal for relaxing or hosting, surrounded by the lush greenery and tranquil setting of the polo community.

Community Features:

World-class polo and equestrian facilities
Swimming pools and fitness centers
Fine dining restaurants and clubhouse
Landscaped greenery and open spaces
Gated community with 24/7 security

Located in a serene yet well-connected area, this villa offers a unique lifestyle combining luxury, privacy, and exclusivity—ideal for both end-users and investors seeking a distinguished address in Dubai.
